decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach with both arms separated. Plan pens to left basket, cars to middle, watches to right; object locations require visual refinement.
Advance above left black pen and silver watch, rotating toward downward tool axes with clearance.
Finish downward orientation and align left jaws across the pen. Lower cautiously toward both targets, keeping grippers open.
Refine alignment from wrist views: offset left onto pen and advance toward silver watch, descending incrementally before closure.
Close on aligned black pen and silver watch, then make a short vertical retention check. Grasp success will be judged from object motion.
Both objects moved with jaws in RGB. Lift clear of basket rims, then transport pen over white basket and silver watch over red without crossing arms.
Continuity guard stopped transport. Replan with smaller forward increments, lowering and slightly tilting tools to place inside baskets while preserving elbow-up posture.
Release pen in white basket and watch in red basket, then retract with clearance. Next targets are the white pen and black wristband.
Move above white pen and black watch with open jaws. Reorient the left jaws across the white pen while keeping each arm in its own workspace.
Resume from executed prefix with reduced yaw increments after continuity rejection. Approach above white pen and black watch, not yet closing.
Use wrist views to refine downward alignment. Lower left toward white pen and right slightly toward black watch; keep jaws open until the objects are between them.
Center the white pen across the left jaws and the black watch across the right jaws. Close fully, pause, and lift slightly to check retention visually.
Retention is uncertain from the small lift. Raise both slightly further without lateral transport to distinguish a grasp from jaws closing above the objects.
Neither object followed the lift. Reopen and descend below the previous closure height; advance the right jaws slightly toward the wristband center.
Left descent encountered table-level resistance; close from observed height. Recenter right wristband longitudinally at its lower approach height, then close and lift for visual confirmation.
White pen and black watch now visibly move with the jaws. Lift clear and begin separated transport toward their category baskets, keeping both grippers closed.
White pen retained; bring it over white basket. Black watch slipped back to table, so reopen and return with a changed jaw angle for a firmer grasp.
Release white pen into its basket and retract. Lower right jaws toward the black watch's face rather than only its loose band, then close.
Approach the remaining black pen with left arm. Maintain right closure and lift the watch slowly to verify retention before transport.
Lower and center left jaws on the last pen. The black watch is retained in RGB; transport it slowly toward the red basket with a small forward tilt.
Align left jaws more closely across the pen, close and make a short test lift. Continue bringing the retained black watch over the red basket.
The black watch is now inside the red basket; open and clear it. Lift the retained last pen, while positioning the right arm above the red car.
Carry the last pen over the white basket. Align right jaws across the red car's width and descend above it; cars will go to the blue basket.
Release the third pen into the white basket. Center right jaws near the red car's body and lower slightly before closing; verify retention next.
Lift the red car vertically to confirm it follows the jaws. Pens appear grouped in white; begin withdrawing the empty left arm toward its origin.
Red car did not remain held. Reopen, shift the grasp toward its middle body and descend again. Continue returning the empty left arm without changing elbow branch.
Close around the red car's centered body and test a slow vertical lift. Finish bringing the empty left arm near its initial pose.
Red car now visibly follows the jaws. Lift and carry toward the center basket slowly, easing wrist yaw while keeping the empty left arm parked.
Car remains held but has pivoted in the jaws. Carry it over the right half of the blue basket with small continuous increments; keep closure until fully over the interior.
The car slipped outside the blue basket and the reach guard interrupted. Retract to a safer bent-arm pose, open, and let the car settle before a centered regrasp.
Reorient the open right gripper above the two cars. The red car is leaning beside the blue basket; obtain a clearer centered approach rather than dragging it against the rim.
Align across the red car's newly angled body and descend with open jaws. Keep the parked left arm clear while refining the grasp visually.
Refine right-jaw centering over the red car's roof with a shallow descent, avoiding premature closure on an end of the car.
Shift slightly toward the red car's center at the observed contact height, close fully, then perform only a short vertical grasp test.
The jaws closed above the red car. Reopen and descend 3 cm at the centered position before closing again; do not transport without a visible retention test.
Lift the red car slowly away from the basket wall while holding closed. Check whether the body remains between the jaws before moving toward the blue basket.
The red car is held by its rear and hangs downward. Raise it clear of the rim while gently tilting forward and moving toward the blue basket, keeping closure throughout.
Car remains retained and clear of the front rim. Move over the blue basket interior with small continuous increments and additional forward tilt.
Release the red car over the blue basket interior and allow it to settle. Withdraw the open right jaws before approaching the remaining cyan car.
Red car is settled in blue. Reorient the open right gripper downward and approach the remaining cyan taxi, keeping the left arm parked.
Cyan taxi is aligned across the open jaws. Lower gradually toward its body and advance slightly for a centered grasp.
Lower the final centimeter around the taxi body, close and pause, then make a short vertical retention test.
Taxi is visibly between the jaws after the short lift. Raise slowly to clear the basket rim and add forward tilt, maintaining full closure.
Taxi remains steadily held. Carry it over the blue basket with the other car, keeping the right arm on its side and lowering only slightly.
Release the cyan taxi inside the blue basket and let both cars settle. Retract the open right arm and begin a continuous return to its initial orientation.
All visible objects are in category-specific baskets. Return the right arm toward its origin and make a small left-arm origin correction, with both grippers open.
